result.note: Tests the first round of India–Maldives free trade talks in July 2026: round, scope and trade figure.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–Maldives free trade talks concluded in July 2026:
items: The talks concluded in July 2026 were the first round of negotiations.
The talks covered eight policy areas.
Bilateral trade between India and the Maldives in 2025-26 was below USD 1 billion.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. India and the Maldives concluded the first round of free trade talks, spanning eight policy areas, and bilateral trade stood at USD 771.76 million in 2025-26. The round concluded on Wednesday, 15 July 2026.
questions.source: India and the Maldives concluded the first round of free trade talks across eight policy areas, with bilateral trade at USD 771.76 million in 2025-26.
